title: A month without Earth
summary: In the month when Earth is least in view, robots that share jobs and roads among themselves leave {{r:with_urgent}} urgent items waiting and need {{r:with_hand}} of hand coordination from Earth; without the network the month ends with {{r:without_urgent}} urgent item waiting and {{r:without_hand}} of coordination by hand.
notes: Draft by FRONTEND (F-56), not browser-checked. Numbers: the with/without pair of B-80 (data/atc/trace_pair/index.json, July 2028, one seed). The story schema reads JSON numbers only from results/*.json, so the counters point at results/ATC_trace_pair_summary.json, a file BACKEND would export with the index's window and runs.{with,without}.{summary,settings} under the same paths; Earth visibility already comes from results/E48_sizing.json. Scene: the story player has to show the pair (modes.view = atc_pair, run = with / without / both), which it does not do yet; world:P2 is the schema-valid default until then. Wording for LEAD to edit; LEAD moves the file to data/stories/ when accepted.

base_dte.label: Earth in view of the base, that month
base_dte.note: share of the month with Earth above the base's horizon; the least of the year (the month the trace pair shows)

loss.label: Message loss on the mesh
loss.note: per-hop loss set for the run with the network

without_hand.label: Without: hand coordination through Earth
without_hand.note: operator hours spent settling road conflicts by hand through Earth in the month

with_msgs.label: With: messages per hour, whole fleet

steps.title: The month Earth is least in view
steps.text: In the simulated year shown, the base sees Earth least in July: {{r:base_dte}} of the time. For the rest of the month no control room on Earth can reach a rover directly.
steps.visual: The base from above in July, with the Earth chip showing when Earth is in view and when it is hidden.

steps.title: Without the network
steps.text: Each company's control room on Earth assigns its own robots while Earth is in view, and road conflicts are settled by hand through Earth: {{r:without_hand}} of hand coordination this month. When the month ends, {{r:without_urgent}} urgent item is still waiting.
steps.visual: Robots of one company stand idle while another company's cargo waits; a road conflict waits for Earth to rise.

steps.title: With Lunar ATC
steps.text: The robots auction pooled jobs among themselves over the radio mesh, with {{r:loss}} of messages lost on each hop, and reserve the roads together. Hand coordination through Earth: {{r:with_hand}}. Urgent items still waiting when the month ends: {{r:with_urgent}}.
steps.visual: Radio links between the robots, reserved road segments in colour, and jobs passing to whichever robot can finish them soonest.

steps.title: Fewer idle hours
steps.text: Across the fleet, robots sit idle {{r:with_idle}} with the network against {{r:without_idle}} without it: {{r:idle_saved}} less in one month.
steps.visual: The two months side by side on one clock, with the idle robots of each marked.

steps.title: What it costs, and what this is
steps.text: The network talks: about {{r:with_msgs}} messages an hour across the whole fleet, a light load on the radio. This is one simulated month and one seed, a picture of the idea rather than a result; the papers give averages over thousands of simulated years.
steps.visual: The message counter beside the two months; a note that this is a single run.
